introduction: This spec adds the `landlock`, `podman` and `none` box providers beside `local`, and adds a headless `claude` brain behind the existing `Brain` interface. With them, `af triage` and `af fix` can put the brain's tree in a real box on a developer's machine, or knowingly in no box. Under every provider, `.git` never leaves the host, the commit that counts is made on the host from facts `af` measured, and the model vendor's key is the only credential that reaches the brain.

glossary.Landlock ABI: The Linux Landlock version that the `landlock_create_ruleset` version query reports. ABI 4 is the first with network rules.
glossary.borrowed hands: The `--borrowed-hands` mode, where the agentkit driver runs on the host and drives the box's tools instead of running inside the box.
glossary.foreign commit: A commit that appears on the checkout's history while the brain runs under `none` and that `af` did not make.
glossary.in-place session: The `*box.Session` that the `none` provider returns. The developer's checkout is the tree, so nothing is synced or exported, and `InPlace()` reports true.
glossary.isolating provider: A box provider that confines the brain: `landlock` and `podman`. `local` and `none` are not isolating.
glossary.placement: Where a brain runs for one run: `host` (af's process, over the box's tools), `box` (a process inside the box), or `checkout` (a process on the host checkout under `none`).
glossary.probe: A once-per-session check, before the first process-brain run, that the `af` binary runs, the `claude` binary runs where it is needed, and `HOME` is set and writable inside the box.
glossary.process brain: A brain that runs as a separate process through `Session.Exec`: `claude` under every provider, and `agentkit` inside `landlock` or `podman` without `--borrowed-hands`.
glossary.tools image: `quay.io/agentfox/tools`, which is the sandbox image plus `af` and Claude Code. It is built from `containers/tools/Containerfile` and is the default `podman` image.

requirements.title: Choosing the box
requirements.rationale: An unconfined default would quietly remove the boundary that keeps credentials away from the brain, so the default must be a real box and must never fall back silently.

criteria.action: register the providers `landlock`, `podman`, `local` and `none`, and have each declare whether it isolates (true only for `landlock` and `podman`) and whether it works in place (true only for `none`)

criteria.condition: `--sandbox` names a value other than `landlock`, `podman`, `local` or `none`
criteria.action: reject the invocation before any box opens
criteria.contract: status failed with category `usage`; the message lists all four provider names

criteria.condition: a run starts without `--sandbox`
criteria.action: select the provider from `AF_SANDBOX` when it is set, else `landlock` when `runtime.GOOS` is `linux`, else `podman`
criteria.contract: the selected provider name is the one recorded in the `box_open` ledger entry

criteria.condition: `AF_SANDBOX` is set to a value that is not one of the four provider names
criteria.action: reject the invocation before any box opens
criteria.contract: status failed with category `usage`; the message names `AF_SANDBOX` and lists the four provider names

criteria.condition: the default-selected provider fails to open
criteria.action: return the provider's failure without falling back to `local` or `none`
criteria.contract: status failed/`sandbox` whose `fix_hint` names `--sandbox` and `AF_SANDBOX`; no brain process is started

criteria.condition: a run opens a `local` or `none` box
criteria.action: raise the warning `box_unconfined` exactly once per run, where under `none` the message says that the brain works on the checkout itself and that the hook is the only guard
criteria.contract: exactly one `box_unconfined` entry in the result's warnings

criteria.condition: `--borrowed-hands` is given with a brain other than `agentkit`
criteria.action: reject the invocation before any box opens
criteria.contract: status failed with category `usage`; the message names `--borrowed-hands` and `agentkit`

requirements.title: The box spec for a run
requirements.rationale: A single function from brain, provider, borrowed-hands mode and tools to the box request makes the rule that only the vendor key crosses into the box testable in one place.

criteria.action: compute the placement from the brain entry, the provider, `--borrowed-hands` and `Brief.Tools`: `host` for `scripted`, and for `agentkit` under `local`, under `none` or with `--borrowed-hands`; `box` for `claude` under `local`, `landlock` and `podman`, and for `agentkit` under `landlock` and `podman` without `--borrowed-hands`; `checkout` for `claude` under `none`
criteria.contract: the triage and fix loops open their box with the request this function returns

criteria.action: for any combination of brain, provider and `--borrowed-hands`, set `Spec.Env` to exactly the host values of the credential names for the placement: an empty map for `host`, and only `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` for `box` and `checkout`, with no other host variable passed into the box by any other route
criteria.contract: with `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `GH_TOKEN`, `GITLAB_TOKEN` and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` set on the host, `Spec.Env` for `claude` is `{ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}`, and for `scripted` and `agentkit --borrowed-hands` it is empty

criteria.action: set the network to `none` when the placement is `host` and `Brief.Tools` holds no `execute` tool, and to `open` otherwise, and record it as `host` under `local` and `none`, where nothing is enforced
criteria.contract: `Spec.Network` is one of `none`, `open` or `host`

criteria.action: for `podman`, set `Spec.Image` to `AF_SANDBOX_IMAGE` when it is set and to `quay.io/agentfox/tools:latest` otherwise, and leave the image empty for the other providers
set the TTL to the time left on the command's deadline plus 10 minutes, set `RequireLandlock` for `landlock`, and set the labels as spec 07 does

criteria.condition: a box opens for a run
criteria.action: record the ledger entry `box_open` with the fields `image`, `network` and `placement` added
criteria.contract: the `af fix` result carries `box: {provider, image, network}`, and the regenerated `fix` schema golden includes it

requirements.title: The landlock provider
requirements.rationale: A box that cannot confine the network when asked for `none` would break the borrowed-hands guarantee, so `landlock` requires ABI 4 and fails closed.

criteria.condition: `landlock` is selected on an OS other than Linux
criteria.action: refuse before any sandbox is created
criteria.contract: status failed/`sandbox`, `retryable: false`, message `landlock needs Linux`, `fix_hint {flag: "--sandbox", suggest: "podman"}`

criteria.condition: `landlock` is selected on Linux
criteria.action: read the Landlock ABI with the `landlock_create_ruleset` version query (syscall 444, flag 1), behind a package-level function variable that tests can replace
criteria.contract: the ABI integer, or a value meaning that Landlock is absent

criteria.condition: the Landlock ABI is below 4 or Landlock is absent
criteria.action: refuse before any sandbox is created
criteria.contract: status failed/`sandbox`, `retryable: false`; the message names the ABI found and the ABI 4 needed; `fix_hint {flag: "--sandbox", suggest: "podman"}`

criteria.condition: the Landlock ABI is 4 or higher
criteria.action: create the sandbox through agentkit's `landlock` provider with the spec from 10-REQ-2, and follow spec 07's contract: sync in with `.git`, export without it, and fail an export that carries `.git`
criteria.contract: a `*box.Session` whose `InPlace()` is false; an export that contains `.git` returns a `sandbox` failure

requirements.title: The podman provider and the tools image
requirements.rationale: Without a recipe for the image in the repository, `podman` with `claude` has nothing to run, and an engine or image failure needs a clear, actionable message.

criteria.condition: the podman engine cannot be reached
criteria.action: refuse before any brain runs
criteria.contract: status failed/`sandbox`, `retryable: false`; the message carries the provider's error and, on an OS other than Linux, mentions `podman machine start`; the `fix_hint` names `--sandbox`

criteria.condition: the image is missing and cannot be pulled
criteria.action: refuse before any brain runs
criteria.contract: status failed/`sandbox`, `retryable: true`; the message names the image and `AF_SANDBOX_IMAGE`

criteria.condition: the image's `af --version` differs from the running binary in `version` or `commit`
criteria.action: raise the warning `box_af_version_mismatch` and continue the run, with the host re-validating every submission
criteria.contract: one `box_af_version_mismatch` entry in the warnings; the run status is not changed by the mismatch

criteria.action: build from `ARG BASE_IMAGE` (default `quay.io/agentfox/sandbox:latest`); build `af` from the repository context, with agentkit-go cloned at `ARG AGENTKIT_REF` into the path the `replace` directive expects; install Claude Code at `ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION`; and keep `WORKDIR /workspace` and `USER 1001:0`

criteria.condition: `make build-tools-container` runs
criteria.action: build the tools image tagged `$(CONTAINER_REGISTRY)/tools:$(VERSION)` and `$(CONTAINER_REGISTRY)/tools:latest`, with `build-containers` building it after the sandbox image

requirements.title: The none provider's in-place session
requirements.rationale: Making `none` an in-place `Session` instead of a nil box keeps one code path for every brain and both loops.

criteria.condition: `box.Open` is called with `none` on a directory that passes spec 07's top-level check
criteria.action: return a session whose `InPlace()` is true, whose `Root()` is the checkout's path, and whose `Spec()` has network `host` and `Env` as in 10-REQ-2; every other provider's session reports `InPlace()` false and a `Root()` equal to the workspace root as seen inside the box
criteria.contract: a `*box.Session` with the stated `InPlace`, `Root` and `Spec` values

criteria.condition: a session is in place
criteria.action: serve `Tools()` as the hands' tool set over the checkout itself, and serve `FS(ctx)` as a read-only view of the checkout through `os.OpenRoot`
criteria.contract: a write through the `FS` view fails

criteria.condition: a session is in place
criteria.action: accept `WriteFile` only for paths under `.agent-fox/`, write atomically on the host, and leave an existing `.agent-fox/.gitignore` unchanged
criteria.contract: a path outside `.agent-fox/` returns spec 07's error and writes nothing

criteria.condition: a session is in place
criteria.action: have `Sync` record `box_sync {head}` and copy nothing, and have `Close` record `box_close`
criteria.contract: ledger entries `box_sync` and `box_close`; no files are copied

criteria.condition: `Export` is called on an in-place session
criteria.action: return an internal error without copying any file
criteria.contract: an error with the message `in place: nothing to export`

criteria.condition: `brain.Execute` runs an attempt over an in-place session
criteria.action: keep the bytes of the last host-accepted `<run_dir>/submission.json`, if there is one, before the brain runs, and rewrite the file with the same bytes when this attempt's submission is accepted

criteria.condition: an attempt's submission under an in-place session is not accepted
criteria.action: move the file to `submission.rejected.<attempt>.json` when it differs from the kept bytes, then restore the kept bytes, or leave no file when none were kept
criteria.contract: `<run_dir>/submission.json` holds the previously accepted bytes or does not exist

criteria.action: for any sequence of accepted and rejected attempts under an in-place session, leave `<run_dir>/submission.json` holding only a submission the host accepted, as under `local`

requirements.title: The host-side commit under each provider
requirements.rationale: The commit that counts must be made on the host from measured facts, and under `none` that means neutralising commits the brain made on the checkout itself.

criteria.condition: the provider is `landlock`, `podman` or `local`
criteria.action: read the tree through `Session.Export` without change, so that a modified file, a new file, a deleted file and an executable-bit change made inside the box all arrive in `af`'s single commit with the `Agent-Fox-Run:` trailer, a commit made inside the box is not on the branch, and files the box's user wrote are owned by the host user after apply

criteria.condition: the session is in place
criteria.action: skip export and apply, and run the protected-path revert directly on the checkout
criteria.contract: `Export` is never called; `af fix --brain scripted --sandbox none` lands `fix/<N>-<slug>` with one commit carrying the `Agent-Fox-Run:` trailer

criteria.condition: a brain run is about to start over an in-place session
criteria.action: record HEAD as a full commit hash, through a new `(*gitx.Git).RevParse`, together with the checked-out branch

criteria.condition: a brain run over an in-place session ends and the branch and full HEAD equal the recorded ones
criteria.action: continue to measuring without touching git

criteria.condition: a brain run over an in-place session ends with HEAD moved
criteria.guard: the branch is unchanged and the recorded HEAD is an ancestor of the current HEAD, checked through a new `(*gitx.Git).IsAncestor` where exit code 1 means false
criteria.action: run `git reset --soft <recorded>`, raise the warning `foreign_commits_reset {count}`, record it in the ledger, then measure and commit the change as usual
criteria.contract: the foreign commits are gone from the branch, their change is inside `af`'s commit, and one `foreign_commits_reset` warning is raised

criteria.condition: after a brain run over an in-place session, the branch differs, HEAD is detached, or the recorded HEAD is not an ancestor of the current HEAD
criteria.action: stop without touching the tree, and without landing or parking anything
criteria.contract: status failed/`git`, `retryable: false`; the message names the recorded and current branch and HEAD

requirements.title: Running a brain as a process
requirements.rationale: Process brains need one execution contract that keeps every host variable except the vendor key out, under every provider.

criteria.action: provide `Exec(ctx, command, timeout)`, which runs the command through the box's `execute` tool at `Root()` for box providers, and with `sh -c` on the host at the checkout for `none`, through a new exported `gitx` runner that takes an explicit environment, kills the process group, and starts from `tools.ReducedEnv(nil)` plus `Spec.Env`
criteria.contract: the exit code and the output capped in size; a non-zero exit is returned as a code, not as an error

criteria.condition: the first process-brain run of a session is about to start
criteria.action: probe once per session: run `<af> --version`, run `<claude> --version` for `claude`, and check that `HOME` is set and writable
criteria.contract: one ledger entry `box_probe {binary, ok, version}` per probe

criteria.condition: any probe fails
criteria.action: stop before the brain starts
criteria.contract: status failed/`sandbox`, `retryable: false`; the message names the binary, the provider and the image

criteria.action: under `local`, `landlock` and `none`, resolve `af` to the running executable's absolute path (overridable through `Options.AFPath`) with its directory first on `PATH`, and resolve `claude` with `exec.LookPath` on the host; under `podman`, call both by name from the image's `PATH`

start the command under `env -i` with only `PATH`, `HOME`, those of `LANG`, `LC_ALL`, `TZ`, `TMPDIR`, `HTTPS_PROXY`, `HTTP_PROXY` and `NO_PROXY` (in either case), `SSL_CERT_FILE`, `SSL_CERT_DIR` and `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` that are set, and the `Spec.Env` credential names referenced as shell parameters; put non-secret settings such as `AF_MODEL` inline, and single-quote every argument
criteria.contract: no credential value appears in the command text or the ledger

criteria.action: for any host environment in which `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `GH_TOKEN`, `GITLAB_TOKEN` and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` are set, start the process under `local` and under `none` so that it sees `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and none of the three forge-token variables

criteria.condition: a process brain runs
criteria.action: feed the placed `brief.md` on stdin, redirect stdout and stderr through `af`'s own command line to `.agent-fox/run/<id>/<brain>.<attempt>.json` and `.stderr`, and after the process exits copy both through `Session.FS` to the host run directory (the JSON up to 1 MiB, the last 64 KiB of stderr), with neither file deciding whether a submission exists
criteria.contract: one artifact `{kind: "brain_output", path}` per copied file

criteria.condition: the exec timeout, which is `Brief.Timeout` or else the time left on the context, expires
criteria.action: kill the process and its group
criteria.contract: a ledger entry `brain_process {brain, exit_code, duration_ms}`, recorded for every run whether it completes or times out

requirements.title: The claude brain's construction, files and command line
requirements.rationale: Claude Code runs headless with its own hands, so its allowlist, hook and command line are where the guard rules are enforced.

criteria.action: register `claude` with cost source `reported` and the command submission route, so that the agent briefs render `af <agent> submit --run-id <id>` for it

criteria.condition: `claude` is constructed, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is unset, and the provider is not `none`
criteria.action: fail construction before any box opens
criteria.contract: status failed/`auth` with `fix_hint {env: "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"}`

criteria.condition: `claude` is constructed under `local`, `landlock` or `none` and is not on the host `PATH`
criteria.action: fail construction before any box opens
criteria.contract: status failed/`brain`, `retryable: false`, with a message naming `claude`

criteria.condition: a `claude` attempt is prepared
criteria.action: place through `WriteFile`, with host copies in the run directory: `guard.json` in spec 06's format (version 1, `protected_paths` and `allow_programs` from `Brief.Hook`, `suite` omitted), and `claude-settings.json` with one `hooks.PreToolUse` entry matching `*` whose command is `<af> guard check --host claude --dir <root> --policy <root>/.agent-fox/run/<id>/guard.json`, with a 30 s timeout
criteria.contract: the files `.agent-fox/run/<id>/guard.json` and `.agent-fox/run/<id>/claude-settings.json` exist in the box, with copies in the host run directory

criteria.action: run `<claude> -p --output-format json --max-turns <MaxTurns> --permission-mode dontAsk --settings <settings> --strict-mcp-config --allowedTools <…> --disallowedTools <…> --append-system-prompt <note> [--model <AF_MODEL>]` with `brief.md` on stdin, where the note is a fixed text saying that the run is headless, that the only deliverable is one submission through the command the brief names, that it must never commit, push or write to the forge, and that a refusal is the next turn

map box tools to Claude Code tools from one table (`read_file`→`Read`, `list_files`→`LS`,`Glob`, `find_files`→`Glob`, `search_files`→`Grep`, `write_file`→`Write`, `edit_file`→`Edit`,`MultiEdit`, `execute`→`Bash`); drop navigation tools that have no equivalent and record each drop in the ledger; always allow `Bash(af <agent> submit:*)`; always disallow `WebFetch` and `WebSearch`; and disallow `Write`, `Edit`, `MultiEdit` and `NotebookEdit` when `Brief.Tools` has no writer

criteria.condition: the `PreToolUse` command from `claude-settings.json` is run with a Claude Code payload
criteria.action: answer a deny that names `af gate run` for a `Bash` call of `go test ./...`, a deny for a `Write` to `.agent-fox/run/<id>/submission.json`, and `{}` for a `Bash` call of `git diff`
criteria.contract: stdout is a `permissionDecision: "deny"` document or `{}`; exit code 0

requirements.title: Process-brain outcomes and agentkit inside a box
requirements.rationale: A process brain's cost and claim come from its own output, and agentkit must run inside isolating boxes by default to exercise the placement the service needs.

criteria.condition: a `claude` process exits with a parseable output JSON
criteria.action: set the outcome's `CostUSD` from `total_cost_usd` (else `cost_usd`), `Turns` from `num_turns`, `InputTokens` from the sum of `usage.input_tokens`, `cache_creation_input_tokens` and `cache_read_input_tokens`, `OutputTokens` from `usage.output_tokens`, and `StopReason` from `subtype` (`success`→`ended`, `error_max_turns`→`turns`, any subtype containing `budget`→`budget`, anything else→`error`); set `Submitted` to whether the box's `submission.json` carries this attempt's nonce, and leave `Transcript` empty
criteria.contract: a ledger entry `claude_result {subtype, is_error, num_turns, total_cost_usd, usage, session_id}`; the result's `usage.cost_source` is `reported`

criteria.condition: a process brain's output file is missing or cannot be parsed
criteria.action: report cost 0 and continue to the submission decision
criteria.contract: `usage.cost_source: none` and one warning `brain_usage_unavailable`

criteria.condition: a `claude` process exits non-zero and there is no valid submission
criteria.action: return an error from `Run`
criteria.contract: the error carries the last 2 KiB of stderr

criteria.condition: `claude` reports a cost above `MaxCostUSD`
criteria.action: raise the warning `budget_exceeded`, and set `StopReason` to `budget` when nothing was submitted
criteria.contract: one `budget_exceeded` warning

criteria.condition: the provider is `landlock` or `podman` and `--borrowed-hands` is not given
criteria.action: run through the process runner as `<af> <agent> run --run-id <id> --dir <root> --budget … --max-turns … --timeout …`, with `AF_MODEL` inline and `Spec.Env` set to `{ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}`, failing construction when the key is unset
criteria.contract: a missing key gives status failed/`auth` before any box opens

criteria.condition: `brain.Execute` places the run files
criteria.action: add `prefix_bytes`, the byte length of `Brief.Prefix`, to `run.json`, so that `af triage run` and `af fix run` take `brief.md` and `prefix_bytes` from `run.json` when their run-state file is absent
criteria.contract: the submit core ignores fields it does not use

criteria.condition: an in-box `agentkit` process exits and its envelope at `.agent-fox/run/<id>/agentkit.<attempt>.json` parses
criteria.action: take cost, tokens and turns from `usage` with `cost_source: measured`, and the claim from `result.submitted`; map a failure in category `budget` to `budget` or `turns` according to its `fix_hint` flag, and any other failure to `error`
criteria.contract: an `Outcome` with `CostSource` `measured` and `StopReason` one of `ended`, `budget`, `turns` or `error`

criteria.condition: `--borrowed-hands` is given with `agentkit`, or the provider is `local` or `none`
criteria.action: keep spec 07's host placement over `Session.Tools()`, with `Spec.Env` empty

requirements.title: Tests and documentation
requirements.rationale: `make check` must stay offline and free even on a machine with a key, an engine or a recent kernel, while real boxes and real Claude stay testable on demand.

criteria.condition: `af triage <issue URL> --sandbox local` runs against an `httptest` GitHub with `--brain scripted`, `--brain agentkit` on `faux`, and `--brain claude` with a fake `claude` first on `PATH`
criteria.action: leave the same normalised diagnosis bytes in `<run_dir>/submission.json` for all three brains
criteria.contract: the claude run reports `usage.cost_source: reported` with the cost and turns the fake wrote

criteria.action: pass `make check` offline, with no `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, no container engine and no network, and pass `--sandbox local` in every test of `cmd/af` and `internal/*` that relied on the old `local` default
criteria.contract: `make check` exits 0

criteria.condition: `AF_TEST_LANDLOCK`, `AF_TEST_PODMAN` or `AF_TEST_CLAUDE` is set and its prerequisite is present (Linux with Landlock ABI 4 or newer; a reachable engine and the image; `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` set and `claude` on `PATH`)
criteria.action: run spec 07's box invariant tests under that provider, `af fix` end to end with `scripted` and 10-REQ-6.1's set of changes under `landlock` and `podman`, and the contract row with the real `claude` under `local`, and under `podman` when both variables are set

criteria.condition: an opt-in variable is unset or its prerequisite is absent
criteria.action: call `t.Skip` with a reason that names the missing variable or prerequisite
criteria.contract: the test is reported as skipped, never as failed

criteria.action: after `make doc` runs, document: in `docs/cli.md`, the `--sandbox` values and default, `--borrowed-hands`, `--brain claude`, the warnings `foreign_commits_reset`, `box_af_version_mismatch`, `brain_usage_unavailable`, `budget_exceeded` and `box_unconfined` under `none`, and the `fix` result's `box`; in `docs/configuration.md` and `docs/model-usage.md`, `AF_SANDBOX`, `AF_SANDBOX_IMAGE`, which credential enters which box, `AF_MODEL` mapped to `--model`, claude's reported cost checked after the run, and the network per placement; in `docs/architecture.md`, the host settings and `Spec` per brain, the tools image and the placement table; in `docs/development.md`, the opt-in variables and the fake-`claude` script format; and in `README.md`, `containers/tools/`

execution_paths.title: A developer triages an issue with the claude brain in a local box

steps.action: runs `af triage <issue URL> --brain claude --sandbox local`
selects `local` and raises `box_unconfined` once
checks `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `claude` on `PATH` at construction
computes placement `box`, `Spec.Env {ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}` and network `host`, and the local box opens with `box_open {image, network, placement}`
places `brief.md`, `run.json` with `prefix_bytes`, `guard.json` and `claude-settings.json`
probes `af` and `claude`, then runs `claude -p …` under `env -i` with `brief.md` on stdin, redirecting output into the run directory
calls tools that the `af guard check` hook allows or denies, and submits through `af triage submit --run-id <id>`
decides the submission from the box file and copies the output JSON and stderr to the host as `brain_output` artifacts
writes the accepted diagnosis to `<run_dir>/submission.json` and reports `usage.cost_source: reported` with the cost and turns read from claude's output

execution_paths.title: A developer fixes an issue in place with --sandbox none and a foreign commit is folded in

steps.action: runs `af fix <issue URL> --brain scripted --sandbox none`
returns an in-place session over the checkout and raises `box_unconfined` saying the hook is the only guard
records the full HEAD hash and the checked-out branch before the brain runs
edits the checkout, a commit lands on the same branch, and the brain submits
finds the recorded HEAD is an ancestor on the same branch, runs `git reset --soft <recorded>`, and raises `foreign_commits_reset {count}`
skips `Export`, and runs the protected-path revert and the gate on the checkout
lands `fix/<N>-<slug>` with one commit carrying the `Agent-Fox-Run:` trailer that contains the foreign change

execution_paths.title: A developer fixes an issue inside an isolating box

steps.action: runs `af fix <issue URL> --brain scripted --sandbox landlock` on Linux (or `--sandbox podman`)
queries the Landlock ABI, finds 4 or newer, and creates the sandbox with the spec from 10-REQ-2, syncing the tree in with `.git`
modifies, adds and deletes files, flips an executable bit, and commits inside the box
exports the tree without `.git` and applies it to the host checkout
lands one commit with the `Agent-Fox-Run:` trailer that holds all four changes and not the in-box commit, with files owned by the host user

execution_paths.title: The default box cannot open and af refuses to fall back

steps.action: runs `af fix <issue URL>` without `--sandbox` or `AF_SANDBOX` on a non-Linux host whose podman engine is down
selects `podman` as the default
